decisions.reason: The IMU module was promoted from a mention to its own page, a sign of growing commitment, and as a long-lived building block in a modular sensor ecosystem it costs little to carry against aspiration levels.

The industrial AC input module has its own page in both years and featured in a specific launch announcement, so it fits the firm's industrial line and shows no shortfall that would trigger search for other uses of resources.

The solid state relay module is only mentioned on the website, but such modules are cheap to maintain within an established product family, so slack allows the firm to keep carrying it despite modest visibility.
The RGB LED module launched recently and its results are still uncertain, so management will give it time while it shares the platform and its low marginal costs.
Remote access for wallboxes supports the firm's growing wallbox business and adds recurring value to it, so dropping it would undercut a strategic, aspiration-meeting product line.
